transcript.question: Is Cameron Coscia's aggressive roster management actually improving The Stinky Faggots, or is he just tinkering with a team that already wins on talent?

hotSeat.why: Nina Sharpe is favorite on them (+72), Curtis Vaughn is neutral on them (+9)

sides.mel-diaper: The draft board shows Bijan Robinson and Josh Allen carrying this roster, and Coscia's nine waiver moves this season are mostly cheap depth churn, not the reason they're 5-3.
sides.reggie-banks: The scoreboard shows a 5-3 team with the most transactions in the league, and moves like Rico Dowdle putting up 32.4 and Cam Skattebo's 24.1 prove Coscia's waiver wire work is exactly why this roster keeps winning.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Good evening. The Stinky Faggots are 5 and 3, fourth place, and their most active team in this league with nine waiver pickups this season. So: is Cameron Coscia building a contender, or just churning a roster that already works? Mel, you're up first.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: CHURN! NINE PICKUPS AND $76 STILL SITTING THERE — that's not management, that's fidgeting. Bijan Robinson at PICK TWO. Josh Allen at PICK TWENTY-TWO. That's 151.2 and 168.5 on the season, and it's the whole damn team. The nine moves bought a $0 kicker and a $0 defense. Week 9 against GLORY ASSHOLE, The Stinky Faggots lose — they're projected 129.7 to 140. THAT ROSTER IS DRAFT CAPITAL WEARING A WAIVER JERSEY.

claim.text: The Stinky Faggots lose to GLORY ASSHOLE in Week 9

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Cute draft, Mel. Now the scoreboard. Rico Dowdle came off this roster's churn and went 32.4 in Week 5, then 33.9 in Week 6. Cam Skattebo, pick 146, 31 points in that same 185.4 blowout. Bijan didn't do that alone — 5 and 3 did. The Stinky Faggots beat GLORY ASSHOLE in Week 9. Damn right. Scoreboard.

claim.text: The Stinky Faggots beat GLORY ASSHOLE in Week 9

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: DOWDLE?! Reggie, the Week 8 waiver run for this team was WILL REICHARD FOR ZERO AND THE 49ERS DEFENSE FOR ZERO. That's the churn. Meanwhile Week 8: 116.9 points, a 6.1-point loss to Chodie mcgruber, and Josh Allen 24.2, Jaylen Waddle 20.9, Khalil Shakir 20.8 — DRAFTED. Nina, grade it: which column is holding up 5 and 3?

managerMentions.evidence: The Week 8 waiver run for this team was WILL REICHARD FOR ZERO AND THE 49ERS DEFENSE FOR ZERO.

turns.speaker: nina-sharpe
turns.text: Class. The claim is "waivers built this record." Not supported. The nine pickups this season netted a $0 kicker, a $0 defense, and Rico Dowdle. Dowdle scored 32.4 and 33.9 in Weeks 5 and 6 — real, but two games. Bijan at pick two logged 151.2 on the season; Josh Allen at pick twenty-two, 168.5. That's the load-bearing column. Partial credit for Dowdle, none for the rest.

turns.text: Take the partial credit, Nina — I'll take it with a grin. But look at Week 7: A.J. Brown 28.1, Bijan 21.2, and The Stinky Faggots still lose 116.7 to 105.4 to IR Squad. Draft capital was ON THE FIELD and it lost. Week 6, 185.4 — Dowdle 33.9, Skattebo 31, that's 64.9 of it. Depth wins weeks, Mel.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: DEPTH WINS WEEKS?! Week 7 the depth scored 105.4 AND LOST BY 11.3. Here's the receipt you skipped: Cam Skattebo was DRAFTED at pick 146. Drafted! Not a waiver, Reggie — a draft card. And the $0 kicker Will Reichard is stacked behind Jason Myers, the $0 Niners defense behind Denver. THAT'S NOT DEPTH, THAT'S A DAMN GARAGE FULL OF SPARE LAWN MOWERS. Walt, settle it.

turns.speaker: walt-brennan
turns.text: The record only goes back to this season, so I won't pretend it tells me more than it does. Bijan Robinson at pick two and Josh Allen at pick twenty-two are carrying 151.2 and 168.5 apiece; that's the mortgage payment. Waivers bought a free kicker and a free defense. My verdict: draft capital built this, and the churn is just Cameron Coscia rearranging furniture he already owns.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Walt says furniture. Walt, that furniture scored 146 in Week 5 — Dowdle 32.4, Waddle 23, Josh Allen 21.4 — and the wire guy outscored the pick-22 quarterback that day. Week 8, Shakir 20.8 next to Allen 24.2 in a 6.1-point game. Two more receptions off the wire and that's a win. Five and three. Most active roster in this league. Scoreboard.

turns.text: We've circled the wire enough. Dex, walk us through it — those nine pickups, are they reported moves, stated strategy, or just Reggie's opinion of them?
